what_this_is: What Inspiration shows and how (src/inspiration.mjs over the shared reader src/card-sections.mjs, tool:inspiration, the Inspiration screen), ported from Trillion Media's inspiration-layouts.json. `layouts` are the ways to see it (shared card layouts, parts/ui/show/card-layouts): `grouped` shows cards under their section headings, `shuffle` orders them by today's date, `flow` names the look screen-look draws (row, wall, grid); adding a way is one more row. `sources` say where each kind of card comes from: `items` is the path to the list in that reader's answer, `card` maps each card field to the paths it is read from (the first path holding a value wins), `opens` is what opening a card does (`screen` with its `input` read from the card, or `link`), and `edit` true means the card is a clip that can go into a new edit. `sections` are the rows, in order; each `read` names a source, `where` keeps only items whose field (a path) passes every test (equals, not, one_of, at_least, at_most, present), `newest` sorts by a path, newest first; `limit` caps the row. `card_actions` are the actions a card offers when every field in one of its `when` rows equals the card's own (an empty `when` list means every card); `run` names what the action does. `pick_actions` are the pick section's own, and `aspects` give a starting picture shape by kind until a picture loads. `carried` names the keys of this file the answer carries to the screen, and `said` is the one sentence that sums the answer up ({sections} rows, {rows} each as `row`), or `none` when every row is empty.
